1. The same world seed will always generate an identical world.

2. There are 10 biomes in total, creating an infinitely expanding procedurally generated world.

Note: In future updates, after thoroughly optimizing resource distribution, we will enable fully randomized biome generation.

 For now, to ensure a solid core gameplay experience, the current version uses a fixed biome sequence (while terrain within each biome remains fully random).
